name: Zoom Scribe
blurb: Zoom’s Scribe transcription API — a high-ranking hosted model with fast, batch, speaker-separated transcription.
about: Zoom Scribe is the transcription model behind Zoom AI Services, exposed as an API for synchronous and large-scale batch transcription. The current Open ASR result export records `zoom/scribe_v1` at 5.47% average cleaned WER, placing it near the top of the English short-form leaderboard among proprietary systems.

The API accepts common audio and video formats, supports word timestamps, punctuation, channel separation and speaker separation, and can process up to 1,000 files in a batch job. Zoom does not publish a simple public per-minute Scribe price on the current developer documentation, so pricing is listed as usage-based rather than guessed.
install:
# Synchronous Scribe API
curl -X POST https://api.zoom.us/v2/aiservices/scribe/transcribe \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"file":"https://example.com/audio.wav","config":{"language":"en-US"}}'
